999008199.text:
リーベ、手の届く範囲の存在を守りたいと思うのは
それほど悪いことか？

localizations.en: Liebe, is it really so wrong to want to protect those within arm's reach?

999008199.text:
時と場合によります。一般人が言うならともかく
ゴゥ兄様は兄様ですから……

localizations.en: That depends on the time and circumstances. If an ordinary person said that, it would be one thing, but you're you...

999008199.text:
守るべき命にも優先順位があります。
たとえば老人と子ども、どちらを守りますか？

localizations.en: Even lives that should be protected have priorities. For example, an elderly person and a child—which would you save?

999008199.text:
それはナシです。片方だけ選んでください。
より妥当なのは子どもです

localizations.en: That's not an option. You must choose only one. The more reasonable choice is the child.

999008199.text:
子どもを救えば成長し、繁殖も期待できます。
老人は余裕があれば助けますが、優先度は低いです

localizations.en: If you save the child, they can grow up and potentially reproduce. We'd help the elderly person if we had the luxury, but they're a lower priority.

999008199.text:
理屈は分からないでもないが……知らない子どもより、
知っている老人を助けたくはないか？

localizations.en: I understand the logic, but... wouldn't you rather save an elderly person you know than a child you don't?

999008199.text:
それが兄様の短所なのです。
知り合いを優先しすぎてしまう……

localizations.en: That's one of your flaws. You prioritize relationships too much...

999008199.text:
縄張りや群れを優先するのは短絡的です。
人類という種全体を俯瞰すれば……

localizations.en: Prioritizing your pack is short-sighted. You should consider the interests of humanity as a whole...

999008199.text:
リーベ、お説教は後だ！
今はこいつらを倒すぞ！

localizations.en: Save the lecture for later! Right now we need to take these things down!

999008199.text:
魔物の巣にしては数が少なかったですね。
この程度ならわざわざ「管理」対象にしなくても……

localizations.en: There weren't very many, especially for a monster nest. With numbers this small, there's no need for management...

999008199.text:
おい……当たってほしくないんだが
嫌な予感がするぞ……あっちは……

localizations.en: Hey... I really hope I'm wrong about this, but I've got a bad feeling...

999008199.text:
集落を襲う魔物たちと入れ違いになった……？
戻りましょう、集落が危ない！

localizations.en: We crossed paths with the monsters attacking the settlement...? We need to go back—the settlement's in danger!
